about: What the speech model (Moonshine tiny, in the built page) really wrote for spoken lists, and the issue body and title Sayfold makes from each (lab#80). Each clip was made with macOS `say` (the commands are below), then `afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1 <clip>.aiff <clip>.wav`, and played into the page with `node scripts/transcribe.ts <baseUrl> [--cpu] [--snr 10] <clip>.wav`. `from` says which clip, which voice and rate, and where it ran: WebGPU, the CPU (--cpu), or WebGPU with a room's noise at 10 dB (--snr 10). The four clips named list-*.wav are in this folder; the playtester's three transcripts came from their own clips on PR #4. tests/unit/list.test.ts checks every one.

clips.list-commas.wav: say -v Samantha -r 200 -o list-commas.aiff "Groceries for the weekend. List. Milk. Bread. Eggs. End list. Then call the bank."
clips.list-sentences.wav: say -v Samantha -r 170 -o list-sentences.aiff "Groceries for the weekend. [[slnc 700]] List. [[slnc 600]] Milk. [[slnc 500]] Bread. [[slnc 500]] Eggs. [[slnc 600]] End list. [[slnc 700]] Then call the bank."
clips.list-end-of.wav: say -v Samantha -r 170 -o list-end-of.aiff "Packing for the trip. List. Passport. Phone charger. Rain jacket. End of list. Leave at nine."
clips.list-prose.wav: say -v Daniel -r 180 -o list-prose.aiff "Read the report and list the costs, then make a list of the plants. My shopping list is long."
